newest.title: Meta Blames Claude AI for Account Bans: How to Protect Your Online Presence
newest.description: Meta Blames Claude AI for Account Bans: How to Protect Your Online Presence. Meta just blamed a Claude-based AI tool for mass-suspending a political coalition's Instagram account. We're breaking down how your own automated tools might accidentally trigger a platform ban and what you can do to stay safe. What we covered: • Meta blames Claude AI tool for erroneous No Kings Instagram suspension • MIT research introduces multimodal AI for crystal structure discovery • Anthropic pledges 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: When an AI agent causes a disruption at work, who should be responsible? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
